title: Valais witch trials
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Valais witch trials", at revision 1356245610, opens: "The Valais witch trials consisted of a witch-hunt and a series of witch trials which took place in the Valais, today part of Switzerland, beginning in 1428. The Valais witch-hunt is the first of the systematic campaigns which would become much more widespread in the decades to come, initiating the period of witch trials in Europe." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4382293, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1428-1434/6 witch hunt and trials in Valais, Switzerland". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
